courses.summary: 加拿大基蒂馬特液化天然氣工程是本課引用官方資料的真實工程背景。研究焦點為峽灣港口、管線終點與液化裝置的共同邊界；課程把公開可確認的地理與項目身分，和自行建立的物料、能量、庫存及故障診斷情境分開，要求學徒逐項提交計算、假設、驗證資料與適用範圍。
courses.summaryEn: LNG Canada is the real engineering context identified by the official source. The study focuses on a shared boundary for a fjord port, pipeline endpoint and liquefaction, separating verified project identity and geography from authored material, energy, inventory and diagnostic scenarios. Learners submit calculations, assumptions, validation evidence and applicability limits.
